integrity: The finite-dimensional beta law and asymptotic thresholds are proved analytically; numerical QR and chi-square checks are supplementary. Underlying Haar beta and Gaussian range-finding methods are classical. Historical mathematical priority remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Only one distinguished singular value, exactly flat isotropic real Gaussian residual tail, exact arithmetic and a single spectral look-ahead indicator. Does not prove full multi-block algorithm failure, arbitrary spectra, numerical-precision behavior, or non-Gaussian universality.
title: Exact false-stopping law for Gaussian spectral look-ahead on one-spike residuals
